Why do you sometimes wake up...
And it's more common than you think.
Studies suggest around one in twelve people have felt it at least once.
When you dream, your brain switches off your muscles, so you don't act out your dreams.
before that switch turns back on.
And your brain is still half dreaming.
Many people feel a heavy weight on their chest...
or sense someone standing in the room.
In Newfoundland, they called it the Old Hag.
A famous 1781 painting even shows a creature sitting on a sleeping woman's chest.
It usually lasts seconds, maybe a minute or two.
Getting regular sleep helps, and so can sleeping on your side.
